events.text: Karlsøy was established as a municipality.
The southern Ullsfjord district was transferred from Karlsøy to Lyngen Municipality.
The western island district was separated from Karlsøy to become the new municipality of Helgøy.
The municipality of Helgøy was merged back into the municipality of Karlsøy.
All of the mainland areas of Karlsøy were transferred to Lyngen Municipality.
The southern part of the island of Reinøya was transferred from Tromsø Municipality to Karlsøy Municipality.
The municipality became part of the newly formed Troms og Finnmark county.
The name was spelled Karlsø prior to this year.
The coat of arms for Karlsøy was granted.
Reinøya was split between Karlsøy and Tromsø municipalities before this year.
The Norwegian government transferred all of Reinøy to the municipality of Karlsøy.
Torsvåg lighthouse began recording temperature.
The record low temperature at Torsvåg was recorded.
The record high temperature at Torsvåg was recorded.
